params.body:
We cannot create a real RealGarant warranty contract to test with: the POST to
`/services/multicontract` makes a real policy at a real partner, which is why it sits in the
`impact` half of `App\Support\Outbound`. But we can prove the half that is ours, which is that
the request leaving Stocklist is the same request the old code sent.

This pull request pins the wire shape of the outgoing calls with `Http::fake()` and assertions on
the captured request: method, URL, headers and the exact body, field by field. No third party is
contacted and the seal stays intact. Tests and documentation only; no production code is touched.

The reference for "what the old code sent" is the first commit of this repository, the imported
Delta codebase (`41173e7a`, "Initial import: Stocklist (De Backer) codebase"). Every service was
read as it was there and compared with today.

## What is pinned

`tests/Feature/RealGarantWireShapeTest.php` (11 tests)

- `POST /rest/auth`: exactly `companyNumber`, `username`, `password`, the password decrypted, no
  session header on the login itself.
- The two headers every authenticated call carries: `X-WMS-Auth` (present and non-empty, never by
  value) and `X-User-Data` with the literal `{"locale":"nl_NL"}`, which is a constant and not the
  dealer's language.
- `GET /services/vehicle/manufacturers`, `GET /services/vehicle/manufacturer/{code}/series`,
  `GET /services/warrantyPrograms/all`.
- `POST /services/vehicle/search`: the six-key body with the empty values dropped (a zero counts
  as empty to `array_filter`, and that is pinned as such).
- `POST /services/multicontract/offer`: `mileageFrom` is today's reading, `mileageTo` and
  `monthFrom` are literal zeroes, `monthTo` is the chosen period.
- `POST /services/multicontract`, the one that cannot be tried for real: the full payload written
  out as a literal, with a comment naming which field of ours became which key (sale price and not
  the asking price, street plus house number as one string, `validFrom` always equal to
  `dateOfSale`, `includedRSA` present even when false).
- `POST /services/multicontract/checkStatus` with only `contractExternalId`.
- `GET /services/multicontract/{id}`: the same url gives the PDF or the fields, and only the
  `Accept` header decides.
- Outside production the contract POST is refused before it is built, and nothing leaves.

`tests/Feature/CarpassWireShapeTest.php` (7 tests)

- `POST observation`: the six fields, including `enterpriseOrganisation` derived from the dealer's
  VAT number with "BE", spaces and dots removed, and `observationType` as the literal
  `VEHICLE_HISTORY_DOCUMENT`.
- A chassis number or mileage typed in the dialog replaces the stored one, in the payload and on
  the vehicle.
- `POST observation/{guid}/correction` repeats the same six fields;
  `POST observation/{guid}/confirm` sends an empty body.
- `GET observation/{guid}/status` without a body, and
  `GET observation/{guid}/status/vhr?language=<locale uppercased>`.
- Basic auth asserted as present and non-empty, never by value, plus the three
  `client-software-*` headers.
- No `CARPASS_URL` means the production web service, so an environment that configures nothing
  sends to the address the imported constant held.
- Without `carpass` in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`, nothing is registered.

`tests/Feature/FlexLeaseWireShapeTest.php` (6 tests)

- `POST {FLEXLEASE_URL}cars` with a list, one object per vehicle, every key written out as a
  literal with the derivation named: `external_id` is (id x 3) + 5, `price_excl_vat` and
  `price_excl_vat_prepaid_amount` are the price divided by the dealer's VAT percentage,
  `catalog_price` is the same price with VAT, `date_of_first_registration` is `Y-m-d`,
  `customer_category` is fleet or particulier, `type_of_car` is always "personenwagen".
- A margin is added before the VAT division, so it lands in both price fields.
- The trailer weight is a literal zero unless a towbar was ticked.
- A fuel FlexLease does not know travels as `null`, with the key still present.

## Every difference found against the imported Delta code

**RealGarant: the payloads are identical.** Search, offer, contract and checkStatus build exactly
the same body as the imported code, key for key and in the same order. That is the reassurance
this was after. Two things around them changed:

1. The login is cached for fifteen minutes per dealer plus username (a failed login for one
   minute). The request it sends when the cache is cold is byte for byte the old one.
2. The contract POST is refused outside production unless `realgarant` is in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`.
   On production nothing changed.
3. `getAssistance()` now filters the price setting by dealer and computes through
   `WarrantyChoice::assistanceFor` instead of `value * months / 12`. That is finding X-12, already
   recorded, and it never reaches the wire.

**Car-Pass: the five paths, methods and bodies are identical.** Three things around them changed:

1. The base address comes from `CARPASS_URL` instead of a constant with the beta url commented
   out beneath it. Unset means the production service.
2. `enteredOrganisation` is the account we authenticate as (`CarpassHttp::username`) instead of
   `$dealer->carpass_username` read straight from the row. On production those are the same value.
   Outside production, where the environment override supplies a test account, the registering
   organisation now matches the account that registers instead of naming a dealer who did not.
3. The registration is refused outside production without `carpass` in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`.

**FlexLease: one difference, and it is in the body.** `fuel` used to be our own fuel name
(`$vehicle->fuel_type?->name_nl`, in two of the three payloads through `ucfirst()`). FlexLease
knows five spellings and answers "invalid fuel" to anything else, so it is mapped now
(`FlexLeaseService::fuelFor`) and a fuel without an equivalent travels as `null`. That is an
existing, deliberate change with its own rule (R S4-7.10); this pull request pins its position on
the wire, not only the mapping. The `cars` call is also skipped entirely outside production, which
it was not before, and which used to throw a 500 on every vehicle save on staging.

## Two new findings

Both recorded in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`.

**X-110 (deze week): the test suite does not run on a per-test cache.** `phpunit.xml` sets
`CACHE_STORE=array`, but `config/cache.php` reads `CACHE_DRIVER`, so the key does nothing and the
whole suite runs on the file cache in `storage/framework/cache`. Found while pinning the
RealGarant login: the cached session token survived between test classes and between runs, so the
login under test never left. `RealGarantWireShapeTest` sets `cache.default` to `array` itself
rather than inherit a login from another file. Not fixed here, because changing which cache the
whole suite uses is a decision of its own.

**X-111 (later): `odometerReading` travels with a varying type.** Off the vehicle row it is a
float (`120000.0`, the model casts it); typed in the dialog it is passed through as the caller
gave it. Car-Pass accepts all of them today (verified against their beta environment on
14 September 2026) and the imported code did the same, so this is a loose end and not a fault. It
is pinned as it is.

## What was not reached

- **Nederland Mobiel.** `OwnStockService::executeNederlandMobielRequest` talks through raw cURL,
  not Laravel's HTTP client, so `Http::fake()` cannot capture it and its wire shape cannot be
  pinned this way. Pinning it would need either an injectable transport or an assertion on the XML
  that `XML::getXML` produces just before the call. Left as an open point.
- **The outgoing webhooks.** Already pinned in `VehiclePublishingTest` (PR 318); not duplicated.
- The FlexLease PDF calls (`car/pdf-pricelist`, `car/pdf-contract`) are not pinned; only the price
  request is. They build a much larger body from an offer and a photo, and they deserve their own
  fixture rather than a hurried one.

## Documentation

Three new sections in `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md` describing the wire shape that
was not written down anywhere: P3-8 (RealGarant, seven rules), P3-9 (Car-Pass, five rules) and
P3-10 (FlexLease, one rule). Every test carries the `@rule` code of the rule it pins.

## Verification

`php artisan test --filter='RealGarant|Flexlease|FlexLease|Carpass|CarPass|Webhook|NederlandMobiel|Outbound|Integration|RulesCoverage'`
gives `OK (153 tests, 608 assertions)`. The full suite gives
`Tests: 803, Assertions: 3399, Failures: 1, Skipped: 1`, the one failure being `BuildStampTest`,
a known worktree artifact.
params.title: Integrations: tests for the request that leaves the building
